# ConvertAllNow

> Free browser-based tools for converting, editing, compressing, and managing images, videos, audio, and PDF files.

ConvertAllNow provides simple online media and document tools that work directly from a web browser. No software installation is required.

Website: https://convertallnow.com/

## Main Features

- Free online media and document tools
- Browser-based interface
- No software installation required
- Image, video, audio, and PDF utilities
- Available in multiple languages
- Designed for fast and simple file processing

## Tools

### Video & Audio

- [Video Trimmer](https://convertallnow.com/en/video-trimmer) — Trim and cut video files.
- [Video Compressor](https://convertallnow.com/en/video-compressor) — Reduce video file size.
- [Video to GIF](https://convertallnow.com/en/video-to-gif) — Convert video clips to animated GIF files.
- [Video to Audio](https://convertallnow.com/en/audio) — Extract audio from video files.
- [Audio Trimmer](https://convertallnow.com/en/audio-trimmer) — Trim audio files online.

### Images

- [Image Editor](https://convertallnow.com/en/image-editor) — Resize, crop, and edit images.
- [Background Remover](https://convertallnow.com/en/bg-remover) — Automatically remove image backgrounds.
- [Image Compressor](https://convertallnow.com/en/image-compressor) — Compress images and reduce file size.
- [Image Converter](https://convertallnow.com/en/photo) — Convert images between supported formats including JPG, PNG, and WebP.

### PDF

- [Merge PDF](https://convertallnow.com/en/merge-pdf) — Combine multiple PDF documents.
- [Image to PDF](https://convertallnow.com/en/image-to-pdf) — Convert images into PDF documents.
- [PDF to JPG](https://convertallnow.com/en/pdf-to-jpg) — Convert PDF pages to JPG images.
- [Markdown to PDF](https://convertallnow.com/en/md-converter) — Convert Markdown content to PDF.
- [Unlock PDF](https://convertallnow.com/en/unlock-pdf) — Remove supported password protection or restrictions from PDF files when authorized.
- [Protect PDF](https://convertallnow.com/en/protect-pdf) — Password-protect PDF documents.

### Social Media

- [Instagram Downloader](https://convertallnow.com/en/ig-downloader) — Download supported Instagram photos and reels.

## Languages

ConvertAllNow is available in:

- English (en)
- Spanish (es)
- French (fr)
- Arabic (ar)
- Chinese (zh)
- Portuguese (pt)
- Indonesian (id)
- Russian (ru)
- German (de)
- Turkish (tr)

Localized tool pages use the language prefix in the URL.

Examples:

- https://convertallnow.com/en/image-compressor
- https://convertallnow.com/es/image-compressor
- https://convertallnow.com/fr/image-compressor
- https://convertallnow.com/de/image-compressor

## Privacy and Security

ConvertAllNow is designed to provide secure file-processing tools through the browser.

For tools that process files locally, files remain on the user's device during processing. For tools that require server-side processing, refer to the site's privacy policy for information about file handling.
